subject: general
question: Which sector outpaces agriculture in India, contributing 9% to the economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fisheries.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The fisheries sector contributes 9% to India's economy, surpassing agriculture's contribution of 4-5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fisheries contribute 9% to India’s economy, outpacing agriculture, which contributes 4-5%.**
 
• Union Minister for Fisheries, Rajeev Ranjan Singh, highlighted this during a virtual ceremony for the foundation stone laying of an Integrated Aqua Park in Tripura.
 
• Tripura's fish demand stands at 1.5 lakh metric tonnes annually, showing the increasing need for aquaculture development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Integrated Aqua Park__

 __
 
• The Integrated Aqua Park in Tripura is part of a larger initiative to develop 11 parks, including four in the northeast, to boost fisheries and aquaculture.
 
 
 
• Fisheries Sector Growth__
 __
 
• The fisheries sector has seen rapid growth, becoming a crucial part of India’s agricultural and food production economy.
 
 
 
• Aquaculture in Northeast India__
 
 
• Northeast India has a significant role in aquaculture, contributing to the region’s economy and food security.
